statement: let w := fun (X : ℕ) => (Finset.range (2*X+1)).filter (fun n => X < n ∧ 50*n < 51*X); let v := fun (n : ℕ) => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n * ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n+2); let E := fun (X : ℕ) => ((w X).filter (fun n => ¬ (n.Prime ∧ (n+2).Prime))).sum v / (X : ℝ); let e := fun (X : ℕ) => Real.log (2+(X:ℝ))^3 / Real.sqrt X; ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, 2 ≤ X → E X ≤ C * e X

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 差二窄窗 · TP-0002 · 同时控制平移前后的高次幂污染
plain_statement.en: New route · Gap-two windows · TP-0002 · Bound contamination at either end of a shifted pair

brief.zh: 把坏项送到 n 或 n+2 的真幂；任一幂至多收费两次，两项对数均有统一上界。
brief.en: Charge a bad summand to a proper power at either end. Each power is charged at most twice and both logarithms are bounded.
